claim: Creates a repeatable practice loop from a short audio file.
sandbox: fake Web Audio scheduler; observe selected audio positions cross the end point and restart at the loop start at least twice

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open demo, wait for service-worker control, set offline, reload demo

claim: Demo data is separate from real data and is discarded when you start for real.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; save a demo loop, start for real, re-enter demo, and assert only its seeded sample remains

claim: The sample loads a four-bar beat.
where: landing action note, demo page, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open ?demo=1 and assert an eight-second 120 BPM four-bar sample is ready

claim: The free practice tool needs no account.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; open the sample from the first screen and use the ready practice desk

claim: Saved loops reopen in this browser after refresh.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; import generated WAV, save at clamped BPM, reload, reopen saved loop and assert playback is enabled

where: landing facts and privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: capture every request while importing and saving generated WAV; assert every request is same-origin

claim: Loop Lab uses no analytics or advertising.
sandbox: capture every request through landing, audio import, and saved-loop save; assert every request is same-origin

claim: Exports and imports saved loops with their audio.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; save generated WAV loop, export JSON, delete database, import JSON, reopen saved loop

claim: Slow playback keeps pitch in place.
sandbox: unit test advances source positions at half speed while each scheduled grain retains its natural playback rate

claim: Rejects clips shorter than 0.05 seconds and incomplete saved-loop files before saving or playback.
where: audio import recovery message, saved-loop import recovery message, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; import a valid 20 ms WAV and a JSON export whose second loop is incomplete; assert recovery, no playback error, and no imported loops
